graham.brief:
The San Francisco number has been walking since it opened, and it never came back. The spread has moved a point toward San Francisco. San Francisco opened somewhere else.

Arizona's pass defense gives up more through the air than almost anyone, 6th-worst in the league. Arizona is the 2nd-most pass-first offense in football, throwing more than the situation calls for. The evidence on Arizona at San Francisco points two directions at once, and that's the finding.

San Francisco has handled extra rushers better than most, and Arizona rarely sends extra rushers. Brock Purdy is the starter who's played 92% of the snaps, and San Francisco carries the 6th-heaviest injury load in the league.

The books are half a step from that on San Francisco. San Francisco is favored by 7.5 with a 48.5 total. I can't get San Francisco off the middle, and the books have moved a little. Purdy's attempts line opened 28.5 and is 30.5 now. If San Francisco throws over the first two series at the season rate, the mismatch is the one to follow.
